# Trading

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. This skill provides analysis and education only: it never executes trades, never accesses a brokerage account and never gives personalised advice. A third-party skill from ClawHub (homepage clawic.com), hosted inside the clawock repository but not written by its author. It teaches and applies technical analysis for stocks, forex and crypto: chart patterns (head and shoulders, flags, triangles, wedges), indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands), support and resistance, price action, multi-timeframe reading, backtesting on historical data, sentiment and market overviews, and trade planning with risk and reward calculations. Its defining feature is the strictest language guardrails seen in this sourcing round: direct imperatives are banned (no buy this, no sell that, no you should), predictions may never be stated as fact, and answers use conditional framing throughout (the chart indicates, traders often consider, historical patterns suggest). On first use it shows its legal disclaimers, written in the style of SEC and NFA patterns, and asks you to acknowledge them before continuing, and it escalates toward a professional when someone mentions life savings, retirement funds, borrowed money or gambling behaviour. Risk comes before any strategy in its rules: position sizing from your stated risk parameters and stop distance, predetermined stops that never move further away...
